title: skill-evals config
description: The skill-evals.config.json of a project: defaults for the options of the commands.

$schema.description: The address of this schema, for editors.

cases.title: cases
cases.description: The directory that holds the cases.

reps.title: reps
reps.description: Runs for each subject and case.

jobs.title: jobs
jobs.description: How many runs may be in flight at once. A positive integer. Each run has its own home, workspace and copy of the subject. results.json lists the records in plan order whatever order the runs end in; results.jsonl and the progress lines follow the order they end in.

retries.title: retries
retries.description: Tries after the first for a run that failed for a reason that is not the agent's: a harness crash (a non-zero exit with no final event), a rate limit (the adapter says so), or a timeout before the harness produced any agent event (its opening init event does not count). A non-negative integer. A rate-limited run waits 30 seconds times its attempt number first. A setup failure, an isolation breach, any other invalid run and a low score are never retried. The run record's attempts lists the error, cost (null when none was reported) and duration of each earlier attempt.

maxCost.title: maxCost
maxCost.description: Stop starting runs once this command has spent this many US dollars, summing agent, judge and decision costs over the attempts it made; reused runs are not counted. A positive number. Runs in flight finish, with their judged and decision checks skipped, so they are invalid and --resume repeats them. The command exits 4. A usage error when a selected harness, the judge or a decision check reports no cost.

maxDuration.title: maxDuration
maxDuration.description: Stop starting runs after this many minutes of wall time. A positive number; fractions are allowed. Runs in flight finish, with their judged and decision checks skipped. The command exits 4.

judgeHarness.title: judgeHarness
judgeHarness.description: The harness that scores judged checks.

judgeModel.title: judgeModel
judgeModel.description: The model that scores judged checks.

judgeApi.title: judgeApi
judgeApi.description: Ask the judge model over this API and start no harness process for it. Only anthropic. --judge-harness is then ignored.

judgeUrl.title: judgeUrl
judgeUrl.description: The base URL of the judge API.

judgeKeyVar.title: judgeKeyVar
judgeKeyVar.description: The variable that holds the key of the judge API. The agent under test never gets it, unless it is one of that harness's own login variables. Default: `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.

judgeTimeout.title: judgeTimeout
judgeTimeout.description: The seconds one request to the judge API may take. A positive integer. A timeout counts as a failed attempt. Default: 120.

judgeFallbacks.title: judgeFallbacks
judgeFallbacks.description: Ask the judge API to fall back when the model refuses: the `anthropic-beta` header and `fallbacks: "default"` in the request. Set it to `false` for a proxy that rejects them. Default: `true`.

decisionModel.title: decisionModel
decisionModel.description: The decision model that scores decision checks.

decisionUrl.title: decisionUrl
decisionUrl.description: The base URL of the decision model's API.

decisionTimeout.title: decisionTimeout
decisionTimeout.description: How long one request to the decision model may take. A positive integer.

minScore.title: minScore
minScore.description: The lowest suite score that passes. The command exits 1 when the suite score of the subject (B for run) is lower.

minDelta.title: minDelta
minDelta.description: The least score difference, B minus A, that the suite must show, on the suite delta and not on its interval. The command exits 1 when the delta is lower. A negative number lets B score lower by at most that much. A case's own minDelta is the same bar for that case. Only run compares two subjects: with score it is a usage error.

noise.title: noise
noise.description: A noise.json that calibrate wrote. A delta that is no larger than the noise it records for its case, or for the suite, reads "within noise", whatever its interval. A case that the file does not list is judged by its interval alone, and the report says so. A file of the wrong shape is a usage error.

seed.title: seed
seed.description: The seed of the bootstrap behind every interval, a positive integer up to 4294967295. The same runs and the same seed give the same report, byte for byte. results.json records it.

maxInvalid.title: maxInvalid
maxInvalid.description: The share of the planned runs that may be invalid, from 0 to 1. The command exits 3 only when the invalid runs divided by the planned runs of the cases that apply are greater than this. A run that did not run because --max-cost or --max-duration stopped the command is not invalid.

report.title: report
report.description: The report formats to write: md, json, junit or html. Repeat the flag or separate formats with commas. md goes to standard output, and only when it is listed. The others go to report.json, report.xml (JUnit) and report.html in the output directory. summary.json is always written there.

maxJudgedWeightShare.title: maxJudgedWeightShare
maxJudgedWeightShare.description: The share of a case's total check weight, from 0 to 1, that `judge` and `decision` checks may carry before `validate` warns. Default: 0.5.

lenient.title: lenient
lenient.description: Drop a key that a case file does not take, and warn, instead of failing. Keys that start with x- are always kept.

isolated.title: isolated
isolated.description: Start the harness with nothing loaded but the subject, and mark a run invalid when the harness reports anything else as loaded. Only harnesses that declare the isolated capability take it.

historyMode.title: historyMode
historyMode.description: How a case's history.json reaches the agent. preamble renders it as a block in front of the first message, which every harness can do. native writes it as the harness's own session and resumes it, and only a harness that declares historyNative can: where it is forced on one that cannot, a case with a history is not applicable. Each run record keeps the mode. Results of the two modes are not comparable.

keepWorkspaces.title: keepWorkspaces
keepWorkspaces.description: After a run's checks, archive its workspace, the seed it started from, its remote directory and its throwaway home as <run>.workspace.tar in the output directory, with the system tar. The harness's login files are left out of the home, and the grader's copy is never in it. results.json records each archive as workspaceArchive. rejudge reads the archive to score the checks that need files again. Needs tar on PATH.

env.title: env
env.description: Names of environment variables the harness gets besides the allowlist. An exact variable name: not empty, without `=`, not `_`, and not starting with `SKILL_EVALS_` or `npm_`. Anything else is an error.

subjectExclude.title: subjectExclude
subjectExclude.description: Globs, relative to the subject, of paths that a run never gets: they are left out of its copy, besides `.git`, `node_modules`, the cases directory and the output directory. `*` matches within one directory, `**` matches any depth, `?` one character, and `{a,b}` either. See [Subjects](../concepts/subjects.md).

rules.title: rules
rules.description: A directory of the subject, such as `"rules"`, whose files are its rules. An adapter with the `rules` capability installs them the way its harness reads them, and the run record keeps what it installed. The path must stay inside the subject and may hold no link. The `none` subject has no rules. See [Rules, hooks and preconditions](../guides/rules-hooks-preconditions.md).

instructionFile.title: instructionFile
instructionFile.description: A file of the subject, such as `"AGENTS.md"`, that the harness reads as its instructions. It is installed with the rules, and its text counts as rule text for `context_injected`. The path must stay inside the subject and may not be a link. See [Rules, hooks and preconditions](../guides/rules-hooks-preconditions.md).
